Please read this document carefully before accessing, using, contributing to, or interacting with the H4ALL Comics platform. Accessing the site constitutes formal, express, and irrevocable acceptance of all clauses contained herein.

1. Purpose, Existence and Nature

H4All Comics exists as a repository, indexer, and digital distribution portal for comics and illustrations of an explicit nature, for exclusive use by adults (18 years of age or older, or the legal age of majority in the user's jurisdiction). Its sole purpose is to provide an optimized web infrastructure for independent authors and authorized users to publish, maintain, and view adult sequential art.

2. Software Nature — MIT License

The source code, scripts, backend logic, and database are distributed under the MIT License. Copyright (c) 2026 H4All Comics Development Team. This license applies exclusively to the software. Comics, illustrations, texts, and other artistic material hosted on the site are private and protected by copyright; MIT permissiveness does not extend to them under any circumstances.

3. Publication and Administration Policy

The administration team reserves the right to index, categorize, pause, or remove any work for maintenance or optimization reasons. Every new comic from unverified users enters a public-invisible isolation queue (Sandbox) until manually audited within a maximum of 24 hours. The platform does not use automated filtering; every upload is visually inspected by the team before being integrated into production.

External links shared via the "Share" function are subject to the site's global regulations. Using them to distribute prohibited content results in permanent account termination with no right of appeal.

4. Zero Tolerance Policy

The following are irrevocably prohibited from upload or linking:

  • CSAM / CP: Any detection will automatically notify the NCMEC and Europol.
  • Child-like aesthetics in fiction (Loli / Shota): Total prohibition, regardless of the character's narrative or justification.
  • Extreme violence (Gore / Snuff): Explicit dismemberment, torture, mutilation or necrophilia exceeding the standards of dramatic fiction art.
  • Biological degradation fetishes: Coprophagia, hazardous fluids, or extreme Vore.

5. Copyright and Takedown Protocol

H4All Comics does not claim ownership of third-party comics and guarantees visible attribution to the creator with links to their official channels. Any rights-holding artist may request permanent removal of their work via verbal request (with identity verification), written request (email or form), or legalized notice (DMCA). The complete technical purge will be processed within a maximum of 12 hours after confirming ownership.

6. Limitation of Liability and Jurisdiction

The software and distribution are provided "AS IS", without warranties regarding server downtime, technical interruptions, or data loss from cyberattacks. The administration reserves the right to amend these terms to comply with banking or regulatory requirements. Continued use of the site after changes are published constitutes full acceptance of the new regulatory text.
